notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for an unconditional attribute-ownership divestiture whose pending Request Attribute Ownership Assumption work survives a standard federation save and restore. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time selection when needed. It verifies object discovery, publication and subscription, pre-save divestiture state, save and restore lifecycle callbacks under both callback models, restored assumption metadata, callback gating for HLA_IMMEDIATE, no premature ownership transfer, and standard federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object declaration, unconditional ownership divestiture, save/restore, callback-control, ownership query, resignation, destruction, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador discovery, save/restore, and ownership-assumption callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador ownership/save/restore declarations and FederateAmbassador object/save/restore/ownership callback declarations
